title: identity.customer-registered v1
description: A customer registered themselves. Raised next to identity.user-registered, which carries no personal data; this event carries the e-mail and what the customer typed, so only the Customers context (to create the profile) binds to it. PERSONAL DATA: never log the body or put it in telemetry. Consumers must ignore properties they do not know: adding one is a backward-compatible change.

eventId.description: Unique per occurrence; the message-id consumers deduplicate on.

aggregateId.description: The account identifier, which is also the identifier of the customer profile.

aggregateVersion.description: Version of the aggregate after the change; detects gaps and reordering.

email.description: Normalized e-mail of the account (lowercase). Personal data.

fullName.description: Name as typed at registration, trimmed; null when none was given. The consumer applies its own rules and leaves the field out when it breaks them. Personal data.

phone.description: Phone as typed at registration (expected in E.164 form); null when none was given. Personal data.

locale.description: Preferred locale as typed at registration; null when none was given.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone as typed at registration; null when none was given.
